text.en:
If your Shoulder Charge Melee Ability is Charged:

Slowly grants 75 HP Overshield over 3 seconds after sprinting for 0.5 seconds.
Overshield disappears instantly if you stop sprinting. 

Grants 50% Melee Ability Energy upon hitting with a Shoulder Charge.

Includes Seismic Strike, Ballistic Slam, Hammer Strike, and Shield Bash.
text.zh-chs:
在满生命值的情况下装备肩撞类近战且充能完毕时：

冲刺后 0.5 秒开始，在 3 秒内逐渐获得 75 生命值的覆盖护盾。
停止冲刺时覆盖护盾立即消失。

肩撞技能击中敌人后回复 50% 的近战充能。

有效的近战技能包括地震打击、弹道猛击、战锤打击、圣盾强袭。

Upon sprinting for 0.5 seconds with a Shoulder Charge (or <arc/>Ballistic Slam) Melee Ability charge:
Charges up a 75 HP Overshield over 3 seconds. This overrides <void/>Void Overshield if active.

Overshield is instantly removed if no longer sprinting. 

Grants 50% Melee Ability Energy upon dealing damage with the mentioned Melee Abilities. Prevents Melee Kickstart from activating.

Upon sprinting for 0.5 seconds with an Eligible Melee Ability charge and while at full HP:
Charges up a 75 HP Overshield over 3 seconds. This overrides <void/>Void Overshield if active.

Overshield is removed if you stop sprinting.

Eligible Melee Abilities include: <arc/>Ballistic Slam, <arc/>Seismic Strike, <solar/>Hammer Strike, and <void/>Shield Bash

Dealing damage with the Eligible Melee Abilities grants Melee Energy:
• <arc/>Ballistic Slam: 25%
• <void/>Shield Bash: 35%
• <arc/>Seismic Strike and <solar/>Hammer Strike: 40%

Prevents Melee Kickstart from activating.
